lib.title: Umtapo
lib.subtitle: Imidlalo engu-{n} enohlelo olwaziwayo · kubuyekezwe ngo-{date}
lib.empty.title: Akukho okutholiwe
lib.empty.text: Zama elinye igama noma uvule “Bonisa imidlalo engenayo i-exe”.
fav.title: Izintandokazi
fav.empty.title: Akukho lutho lapha okwamanje
fav.empty.text: Cindezela inkanyezi ekhadini lomdlalo ukuze uwufake lapha.
detail.notInstalled: Ayikho ikhophi efakwe etholakele, futhi lokho kulungile: i-decoy ayiyidingi.
detail.noteRunning: Inqubo isebenza ngemuva. Unganciphisa iwindi uliyise ku-tray.
detail.noExe.title: I-Discord ayikayazi i-exe yalo mdlalo
detail.noExe.text: Awukwazi ukutholwa ngenqubo. Cindezela u-“Buyekeza isizindalwazi” ngokuhamba kwesikhathi: uma i-Discord ingeza i-exe, umdlalo uzotholakala.
running.title: Okusebenzayo
running.empty.title: Akukho okusebenzayo
running.empty.text: Vula umdlalo emtatsheni bese ucindezela u-“Qala i-decoy”.
settings.title: Izilungiselelo
settings.language.desc: Ulimi lwesixhumi esibonakalayo. Izilimi ezintsha zengezwa njengamafayela kufolda yama-locales.
settings.defaultTime.desc: Mingaki imizuzu yokugcina inqubo (imisebenzi ye-Discord ngokuvamile idinga eyi-15).
settings.autoStop.desc: I-decoy iyaziphelela yodwa lapho isikhathi sesiphelile.
settings.tray.desc: Ama-decoy ayaqhubeka nokusebenza ngenkathi uhlelo lokusebenza luku-tray.
settings.source.desc: Uhlu lomphakathi lwe-Discord · imidlalo engu-{n} · kubuyekezwe ngo-{date}
settings.showNoExe.desc: Okufakiwe lapho i-Discord ingakayazi inqubo okwamanje (azikwazi ukuqaliswa).
settings.dataDir.desc: Lapho uhlu lwemidlalo nezilungiselelo kugcinwa khona.
settings.dataDir.portable: Imodi ephathekayo: konke kugcinwe eduze kwe-decoy.exe.
settings.legal: I-Decoy ayisebenzisi ithokheni yakho ye-Discord futhi ayikwamukeli imisebenzi yebhonasi. Ukulingisa inqubo yomdlalo kungase kube ngokumelene nemithetho ye-Discord, kusebenzise ngobungozi bakho.
toast.launched: “{name}” iqalisiwe imizuzu engu-{n}. I-Discord kufanele iyibone ngemizuzwana engaba ngu-15.
lab.title: Ilebhu
lab.subtitle: Ithebhu eyimfihlo: iqala ama-decoy amaningi ngesikhathi esisodwa.
lab.count.desc: Imidlalo ikhethwa ngokungahleliwe, leyo esevele isebenza iyadlulwa. Umdlalo ngamunye usebenza imizuzu engu-{n} (ebekwe kuzilungiselelo).
lab.warn: I-decoy ngayinye iyinqubo ehlukile enewindi. Ngaphezu kwezingu-200–300 ngesikhathi esisodwa kungase kubambezele ikhompyutha yakho, inani elikhulu ngu-{max}.
notify.title: Isikhathi siphelile
